conflicts.reason_unresolved: Plan bottom chain D24=2000mm at [1.44,3.44] vs South elevation D24=1200mm at [3.44,4.64]. Two dimension chains give different window width and position for same facade. Elevation chosen as authoritative (shows actual window rectangle with inner z-chain).
conflicts.fallback_action: Adopted elevation chain (1200mm at [3.44,4.64]); plan stroke S15 at [0.90,2.90] treated as inaccurate tracing offset. Logged as corr_009.

conflicts.reason_unresolved: Reading-stage interior wall S10 at x=7.56 (estimated from cumulative sum) would split south facade window [6.30,8.70] across two rooms. Dimension chain gives window left edge at 6.30. Topology requirement (each window in one room) forces wall to x=6.30.

F2 bottom dimension chain segments do not sum to outer total 15000mm. Individual segment values from reading stage contain internal inconsistency (e.g. D24 2190 from 5.51→7.50 but 5.51+2.19=7.70). Reading-stage transcription error suspected.
conflicts.fallback_action: Used reading-stage wall positions (S8=3.75, S9=5.51, S10=7.50, S11=11.25) as best available topology evidence despite chain inconsistency; noted in corr_011.

conflicts.reason_unresolved: Reading stage observed 3 interior walls in F1 south zone creating 4 bays, but metadata says 7 thermal zones total per floor (3N+3S+1 corridor=7, implying 3 south rooms not 4). Leftmost bay (x=0.10-3.44) treated as entrance/lobby cell; may merge with corridor in downstream zoning.
conflicts.fallback_action: Emitted all 4 cells; downstream zonification may merge cell_1_SW with cell_1_C.

conflicts.reason_unresolved: F2 cell_2_S2 (x=[3.75,5.51], width=1.76m) is narrow relative to typical office. May be workstation bay or service space rather than full office. Kept as-is; label may change in downstream zoning.
conflicts.fallback_action: Kept cell with role='office'; prior not applied. Width is plausible as a narrow workstation bay in open-plan configuration.

unsupported.reason: West facade F1 entrance door (double-door at local x=[3.40,4.60], y≈[0.00,2.80]) is a door, not a window. No window geometry to emit for west facade F1. The door opening is noted but not modeled as a window per pen library (door → not drawn). Downstream must handle this as a zero-window west F1 wall surface with a door sub-surface if needed.
unsupported.regime_assumption_violated: Door in elevation — correction stage does not model doors; door-healing already done in reading stage for plan walls. Elevation door presence noted.

unsupported.reason: South facade F1 entrance door (door at x≈[0.40,1.04], y≈[0.00,2.10]) visible in South elevation. Similar to unsup_001: door, not window. South facade F1 leftmost bay (x=0-3.44) contains entrance door rather than window.
unsupported.regime_assumption_violated: Door in elevation — same as unsup_001.

unsupported.reason: F2 bottom dimension chain checksum failure (Σ≠15000). Individual segment transcription errors in reading stage prevent clean dimension-chain closure. Cell positions for F2 south zone rely on reading-stage stroke estimates rather than closed dimension chain.
unsupported.regime_assumption_violated: Dimension-chain closure required but segments do not sum to outer total within DIMCHAIN_CLOSE_TOL. Cannot auto-close without guessing which segments are wrong.

criterion.evidence: All perimeter + interior walls traced on both plans; window strokes present on N/S/E walls (F1) and N(2)/S(4)/E(1) (F2). Elevation window counts match per-facade truth (S=7, N=5, E=2, W=1).
Desks/chairs/round meeting table/L-furniture/computers and the grid/dimension lines are NOT traced as strokes; logged in uncaptured_visual_elements.
Plans use wall/window only; elevations use wall_fill (one per floor) + window + outline. Window vs wall not confused on either plan or the South elevation.

1f top chain 1240/2400/1300/... and 2f top chain 1950/3600/1889/1891/3600/1950 transcribed verbatim; South elevation chains 2190/1200/720/1200/4380... and heights 800/1800/1000 + 600/900/1500 match the drawing.
Each elevation declares view_facade from the trusted image name; no east/west written into the in-image axis.
West-F1 (1500 door) and South-F1 (far-left door) healed into continuous wall on the plan; on the South elevation the far-left F1 door is NOT traced as a window. No real opening wrongly healed shut.
F1 = 3 N rooms + corridor + 3 S rooms (meeting/round-table at S-right); F2 = 2 N meeting rooms + corridor + 4 S offices. Both bands and the corridor present and correctly placed.

Two spurious interior partitions over-segment the south bands. F1 south = SW(lobby)+S1+S2+S3 (4 cells) but the drawing shows 3 rooms (2 L-desk offices + 1 round-table meeting), dividers at ~x5/x10 like the north band; there is no real partition near the SW. F2 south = S1..S5 (5 cells) but the drawing shows 4 offices, dividers at x3.75/x7.5/x11.25 only. The extra F2 divider sits at x=5.51, a furniture/window sub-dimension, not a wall.
Perimeter (15x8), the two corridor walls (y3/y5) and the corridor band align across F1/F2; no cross-floor wall jitter.
elev.png matches per-facade truth: South F2=4 + F1=3, North F2=2 + F1=3, East 1+1, West F2=1 (F1 is a door, correctly absent). Windows land on the right facade/floor.

16 zones vs testdata thermal_zones=14 and gt=14 (F1 7 + F2 7). Deterministic tripwire flagged 16!=14. The +2 has no sound explanation — it is the two over-read partitions above, not a legitimate split.

The building cannot be redrawn faithfully from this corrected geometry: F1 gains a non-existent SW lobby and F2 gains a non-existent 5th south office. Geometry otherwise (footprint, corridor, north rooms, windows) is faithful.

row.note: Shifted south perimeter wall from outer face (y=0.00) to centerline (y=0.10) using A4 ext_wall_thk=0.20m prior. Wall thickness not dimensioned in plans; A3 arbitration applied A4 prior for missing thickness.
Shifted north perimeter wall from outer face (y=8.00) to centerline (y=7.90).
Shifted west perimeter wall from outer face (x=0.00) to centerline (x=0.10).
Shifted east perimeter wall from outer face (x=15.00) to centerline (x=14.90).
Interior corridor wall at y=3.00 (face per D13: 250mm wall y=3.00-3.25). Shifted to centerline y=3.125 using dimensioned wall thickness 0.25m from D13+D14+D15 chain.
Interior corridor wall at y=5.00 (face per D15: 250mm wall y=4.75-5.00). Shifted to centerline y=4.875.

Reading-stage interior wall at x=7.56 would split south facade window at [6.30,8.70]. Per A3 arbitration (stroke_vs_dimension: trust dimension chain), moved wall to x=6.30 (window left edge from South elevation D26/D28 chain) so window falls entirely within cell_1_S2.
Adjusted wall from estimated x=11.56 to dimension-chain point x=11.36 (D31 left edge) to align with window boundary; window at [11.36,13.76] falls entirely within cell_1_S3.

Plan bottom chain D24=2000 at [1.44,3.44] conflicts with South elevation D24=1200 at [3.44,4.64]. Elevation is authoritative source for window geometry (shows actual window rectangle with inner z-chain 1500+900+600). Adopted elevation chain values.
F1 south facade left window: sill=1500mm, height=900mm, head=600mm from inner left chain (D20+D21+D22=3000). World z=[1.50,2.40].

F2 bottom dimension chain does not sum cleanly to 15.00m (2190+1200+360+560+1200+2190+2190+1200+360+560+1200+2190 ≠ 15000). Used reading-stage wall positions at x=3.75,5.51,7.50,11.25 as best available topology evidence with note of residual closure error.
All 4 elevations agree: F1 z_floor=0.00, F1 ceiling=3.00, F2 z_floor=3.00, F2 ceiling=6.60. F1 ceiling == F2 floor (contiguous stack). No offset needed.

North facade F1 west window: local x=[1.24,3.64] → world x range (North: local x = -world x, from world x=15.00). World span min=15.00-3.64=11.36, max=15.00-1.24=13.76, but applied along-facade convention: span [1.24,3.64] along world-y=7.90 in increasing eastward direction. z from inner left chain F1: sill=1.00, height=1.60 → z=[1.00,2.60].
S9 at x=5.51 aligns with D23 right edge; window D23=[4.31,5.51] ends at wall face. Accepted as final.
